set.body:
Phase D (architecture). The structural form of P8.A1's hotfix.

core/FailureModel.scala:8-9 puts cluster in JobRef, hence in equality, hashCode, copy and persistence (protocol/AgentDomainJson.scala:1560, StructuredResultCodec.scala:506, managed/ControlCommandJson.scala:54,62) — while observation, accounting, focused probes, parser attribution and cancellation all ignore it. -M/--clusters is emitted NOWHERE: SlurmCommands.scala:145-146 renders only jobid[_arrayindex], and :38-67 never adds a cluster flag to squeue, sacct, scontrol or scancel.

Slurm does expose cluster routing via -M/--clusters for sbatch, sacct and scancel. Implementing it properly requires grouping, CLI routing, parser attribution, persistence AND cancellation to land together.

v0.1 policy (narrower, and the right call):
- operational JobRef becomes single-cluster;
- a reported cluster is preserved as EVIDENCE/metadata, not identity;
- federation and cross-cluster routing are declared UNSUPPORTED, explicitly, in docs.

Implement genuine scoped identity only when all five surfaces are ready together. Epic open decision 4: confirm no near-term site requires -M.
set.title: P8.D4: Single-cluster operational JobRef
